Description: Verify GET /passes/reconciliation returns 401 'unauthorized' when the X-Reconciliation-Token header is absent, and the body discloses NO checked count and NO suspicious list (SEC-ONODE-16-1 replay must report CLOSED)
Steps: Call GET /passes/reconciliation with no X-Reconciliation-Token header
ExpectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized. JSON contains {'detail': 'unauthorized'} — assert the body has NO 'checked' key and NO 'suspicious' key

Description: Verify GET /passes/reconciliation returns 401 'unauthorized' when the X-Reconciliation-Token header is present but does not equal RECONCILIATION_TOKEN (constant-time compare returns false), and the body discloses NO checked count and NO suspicious list
Steps: Call GET /passes/reconciliation with header X-Reconciliation-Token: wrong-token-<dynamic_id>
ExpectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized. JSON contains {'detail': 'unauthorized'} — assert the body has NO 'checked' key and NO 'suspicious' key

Description: Verify GET /passes/reconciliation with the correct X-Reconciliation-Token header returns 200 with the UNCHANGED ONODE-16 body shape — checked is a number and suspicious is a list (auth at the boundary admits the authorized caller)
Steps: Call GET /passes/reconciliation with header X-Reconciliation-Token: qa-reconciliation-token
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. JSON contains {'checked': <any number>, 'suspicious': <any list>} — assert checked is a number and suspicious is a list; do NOT assert the value of checked or the length of suspicious
